dialogueIndex.text: He takes bread from such men.
A man had two sons.
Lift your end.
Again. Leave room beneath it.
There is always another stone.
This one first.
He has come.
You have been in the sun all day.
The lower stones held.
Come. Show me after we have eaten.
Let me see.
It is nothing.
Keep it from the dust for me.
He would weigh the jar again. With the oil still running over his feet.
Father. Give me the share that belongs to me.
What would you do with it?
Leave this place.
Father is still alive.
I know.
For how long have you wanted this?
Since before you went away.
You need not answer him tonight.
Will you sit with me a little longer?
If I stay, the days will pass as they have always passed.
And what is there here that shames you?
I did not say shame.
Then look at him when you speak.
Enough for tonight.
I will divide what I have between you.
You have never slept beyond the next valley alone.
You had not lifted that wall before you began it.
Take the eastern road with the carriers. There is water before the long climb.
I thought you would forbid me.
Would you hear me?
I do not agree to this.
I know.
There is a seam beneath it. Keep that side from the stones.
Come with me as far as the ridge.
Someone must stay.
Your brother's share is given. What remains is yours.
And you?
I shall be here.
Is that all?
Send word when you can.
I will.
That color will trouble you in the heat.
What would you choose?
Keep it.
Come and eat with us.
Bring another. There are more coming.
Sit with me.
The upper course is still loose.
It will stand until morning.
After the wall is finished.
Mattan has asked at the crossing.
I know.
That pays what you owed.
Have you work?
I have no bread left.
You can carry feed?
Leave it. I will call Levi.
He is with the animals.
Your hand.
Must I stand over every handful?
Bring the other basket. I will mend this one.
I spoke harshly.
His hired men have bread to spare.
Father... I have sinned against heaven and against you.
I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Let me work among your hired men.
Come down before the light fails.
I have only this much left.
You have done it well.
There is still—
I can see what remains.
I will go to my father.
Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.
Bring the best robe. A ring for his hand, and sandals.
Prepare the fattened calf. Call our neighbors to eat with us.
Find my elder son. Bring him home.
My son was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.
What is happening?
Your brother has come. Your father has prepared the calf. He sent me for you.
Alive?
Alive. He is in the house.
Tell my father I am here.
Come in. He will see you.
Tell him.
Come and sit with us.
After the wall is finished.
I have come for you.
All these years I have served you. I have kept your word. You never gave me even a young goat to eat with my friends.
He takes what you have worked for. He spends it with harlots. Then this son of yours comes home, and you kill the calf for him.
I was here when you could not eat. I stood beside you on that road. You would not come into the house.
And tonight I came from the field with dirt on my hands... I thought there had been a wedding.
I remember you beside me.
My son, you are always with me. Everything I have is yours.
What has he brought back?
He has come back alive.
We must rejoice. Your brother was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.
